subject: [geom_bar] Clusters ordered by alphabetical order of names

messages.author: a8ea54a97ac8fe2b
messages.subject: [geom_bar] Clusters ordered by alphabetical order of names
parts:
Hi guys,

I use geom_bar to plot two clusters of vectors with R 2.15.1:

# Mean WTP Estimates
WTP_Cod_Wild = 18.14
WTP_Cod_Farmed = 16.46
WTP_Salmon_Farmed = 17.78
WTP_Wild_Monkfish = 20.44
WTP_Farmed_Pangasius = 0.29
WTP_Label_MSC = 0.80
WTP_Label_Organic = 1.84

# Prepare Vectors of WTP estimates
WTP_Vector_Nonlabeled <- c(WTP_Cod_Wild, WTP_Cod_Farmed, WTP_Salmon_Farmed)
WTP_Vector_Labeled <- c(WTP_Cod_Wild + WTP_Label_MSC, WTP_Cod_Farmed + WTP_Label_Organic, WTP_Salmon_Farmed + WTP_Label_Organic)

WTP_DataFrame_Nonlabeled_Labled <- data.frame(Fish_Products = gl(3, 1, 6, labels=c("Wild Cod", "Farmed Cod", "Farmed Salmon")), Treatments = c(rep(c("Nonlabeled", "Labeled"), each = 3)), WTP_Estimates = c(WTP_Vector_Nonlabeled, WTP_Vector_Labeled))

ggplot(WTP_DataFrame_Nonlabeled_Labled, aes(x = Treatments, y = WTP_Estimates, fill = Fish_Products)) + geom_bar(position=position_dodge())

As shown in
    Treatments = c(rep(c("Nonlabeled", "Labeled"), each = 3))
, I'd like to show the cluster of Nonlabeled before Labeled. However, because ggplot2 organizes the x-axis by the alphabetic orders of the two clusters, Labeled cluster came before Nonlabeled cluster.

Can someone offer me a tip to make Labeled cluster show before the Nonlabeled cluster? Thanks!

Kind regards,

Xianwen

messages.author: 9c9b5f9c6aaa025d
messages.subject: Re: [geom_bar] Clusters ordered by alphabetical order of names
parts:
Hi,
You need to factor the variable, in this case Treatments, in the order you want, for it to show up non-alphabetical.

Best wishes,
Doug
